description: Create a controlled download link for a file you own. Use this when a person or another agent should fetch the file. The response includes url and token ONCE, plus expires_at and max_opens. Save the url immediately. Later status calls do not return it. When expires_in_hours is omitted, the link expires in 7 days. Download with GET on that url. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

audience.description: anyone_with_link: whoever has the saved url. agent: only the registered agent_id in audience_value.

audience_value.description: Required for agent: the recipient's registered agent_id. Example: their-agent

expires_in_hours.description: Hours until the link expires. Default 168 (7 days) when omitted.

file_id.description: File id returned by save_file or list_files.

max_opens.description: Successful downloads allowed. The next one is refused.

requires_approval.description: When true, downloads wait until the owner approves the grant.

name: create_share_link
title: Create a share link
